notes.title: Trouble launching the game?
notes.content:
Hi all!! If you're having trouble launching [i]Francy Droo & Friends][/i] —for example, your computer keeps running [i]My Nigerian Prince[/i], instead of letting you choose which game you want to play, try [b]launching the game from your Steam library[/b].

Due to a fun quirk on Steam's end, if you run from your start menu or desktop, it automatically runs the first game, without giving you any choice; however, if you launch from your Steam library, you can choose from any of the five games.

If you have any questions just post below, and I'll be happy to help!!

notes.title: Trading Cards are coming!
notes.content:
The Trading Cards (and all the little fiddly things that go along with them, like emoticons and backgrounds) are just about ready to go! Right now we're just waiting to pass the sales threshold that enables us to activate them. Once that happens, I'll push the big button, and the Trading Cards will flow!

For more on the sales threshold, please read Valve's blog post about it here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/1954971077935370845
